description: Defines the FileUploadSanitizeNameEvent class used during file upload to handle filename sanitization, allowed extensions, and security renaming within Drupal.

classes.name: FileUploadSanitizeNameEvent
classes.description: An event class for sanitizing filenames during file uploads, including handling allowed extensions and security renaming flags.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the event with filename and allowed extensions, processing the extensions into a list.

methods.name: setFilename
methods.description: Sets the filename, ensuring it contains no path information.

methods.name: getAllowedExtensions
methods.description: Returns the list of allowed file extensions.

methods.name: setSecurityRename
methods.description: Flags the filename as renamed for security reasons.

methods.name: isSecurityRename
methods.description: Checks if the filename has been security renamed.

methods.name: stopPropagation
methods.description: Throws an exception to prevent event propagation, indicating it should always be processed.
